UNDER THE HOOD Technical Resilience, Security & Infrastructure API Gateway CORS & Routing Configured HTTP API v2 with wildcard headers (AllowHeaders: *) and a $default route key, eliminating browser cross-origin preflight issues. LocalStorage Persistence Saves API Gateway URLs, S3 bucket names, and IAM keys in browser LocalStorage so page refreshes retain configuration automatically. Direct AWS S3 SDK Upload Integrates @aws-sdk/client-s3 PutObjectCommand to write files directly into paymentdocumentbucket with zero intermediary server lag. 1-Click CloudFormation & Teardown Automated SAM/CloudFormation template deployment and a 1-click teardown button ensuring clean resource lifecycle management.
